policy_title: Support Ukraine and Tackle Russian Corruption
stated: Labour's military, financial, diplomatic, and political support for Ukraine will remain steadfast. They will back calls for a Special Tribunal for the Crime of Aggression and support efforts to seize and repurpose frozen Russian state assets for Ukraine. Labour will also play a leading role in providing Ukraine a clear path to NATO membership and work with allies to tackle corruption and money laundering, including in Britain, Crown Dependencies, and British Overseas Territories.

source.quote: With Labour, the UK’s military, financial, diplomatic and political support for Ukraine will remain steadfast. Labour will support efforts to hold Putin’s Russia to account for its illegal war, backing calls for a Special Tribunal for the Crime of Aggression. We will work with our allies to enable the seizure and repurposing of frozen Russian state assets to support Ukraine. And we will play a leading role in providing Ukraine with a clear path to NATO membership. Labour will also work with our allies and international financial centres to tackle corruption and money laundering, including in Britain, Crown Dependencies, and in British Overseas Territories.

bearing_set.reason: Ukraine military/diplomatic support and NATO membership path directly bear on national security and defence posture; tackling corruption and money laundering in Britain and its territories bears on the justice system and organised financial crime — all core O5 indicators.

membership_note: The policy bears squarely and non-negligibly on O5 (national security/defence posture and crime). Fiscal effects (financial support for Ukraine, frozen-asset seizure) are real but the policy announces no new costed commitment — 'remain steadfast' reaffirms existing direction; frozen assets are earmarked for Ukraine, not the UK exchequer — so O12 does not reach the non-negligible threshold. The Special Tribunal angle touches on international rule of law but is too removed from domestic due-process indicators for O9. Anti-corruption measures could have minor O13 (City/investment-environment) or O9 (rule-of-law) spillovers but no specific mechanism is concrete enough to earn a verdict.
